title: Trash's Counterattack
next_chapter_hook: Just as Zhao Yuan knelt and kowtowed begging for mercy, a cold snort came from the back of the crowd—the first genius of Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie, could no longer hold back, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a previously unseen weight and wariness.

text.content: The morning wind at the Martial Arena carried a chill, yet it couldn't cool the thousands of scorching gazes from the surrounding stands. Tianqing Sect's triennial Outer Disciple Competition finally began on this day. Amidst the crowd's whispers, one name was repeatedly mentioned—Trash Chen Ji, that guy whom even servants in the sect dared to bully, actually had the audacity to sign up today, truly asking for humiliation.

dialogue.content: Hmph, does this kind of trash deserve to stand here?

text.content: On the high platform on the west side of the crowd, several elders sat on both sides. Fifth Elder's eyes swept coldly over the competing disciples, his lips slightly moving as if conversing in whispers with someone. Grand Elder sat stroking his beard with an impassive expression, yet his gaze occasionally drifted toward a specific direction—where Chen Ji stood quietly at the end of the line, seemingly isolated from the surrounding commotion.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring in heart) Three moves. Just three moves. More would be a waste.

text.content: The draw results were swiftly announced. When Chen Ji's name appeared alongside another's on the first-round matchup board, snickers erupted from the spectators. Zhao Yuan—the outer disciple who had previously stepped on Chen Ji's head and walked away triumphantly—now stood nearby, mocking Chen Ji with an obscene throat-cutting gesture.

dialogue.content: Zhao Yuan, teach this trash a lesson for me. Let him understand the vast difference between heaven and earth!

text.content: Zhao Yuan grinned wickedly, saluting in Han Lie's direction before turning his gaze to Chen Ji. With a loud, mocking voice, he proclaimed, "Brother Chen Ji, don't kneel too quickly when we get on stage. I haven't had my fun yet!" Surrounding disciples erupted in chorus of laughter. Some even started placing bets on how many moves Chen Ji would last against Zhao Yuan. Yet, no one noticed the subtle curve forming at the corner of Chen Ji's lowered eyes—a predator's quiet smile before the hunt.

At the third hour of Chen Shi, the copper gong sounded. In the center of the Martial Arena, Chen Ji and Zhao Yuan stood facing each other. Sunlight cascaded from above, stretching their shadows long across the ground. Zhao Yuan crossed his arms confidently, wearing an expression of certain victory. "Trash, considering we're fellow disciples, if you kneel down and kowtow three times now, I might consider only breaking one of your legs."

choice.prompt: How to respond to Zhao Yuan's public humiliation?

choices.text: Cold smile, stay silent, use stillness to overcome movement
choices.description: Maintain the trash persona, let the opponent underestimate even more, only reveal true strength at the most critical moment.
choices.risk_hint: Might be perceived by the audience as truly cowardly
choices.process_label: 冷冷扫了赵元一眼，并未开口

text.content: Chen Ji merely lifted his eyes slightly, his gaze as calm as a still ancient well. That indifferent expression in Zhao Yuan's eyes became a silent provocation instead. "This trash still dares to put on airs?" Zhao Yuan's expression darkened, spiritual energy surging around his body as he launched the first strike!

choices.description: Neither show weakness nor speak too much, directly intimidate the opponent with a master's composure while conserving strength.
choices.risk_hint: Might alert experts to something suspicious
choices.process_label: 语气淡漠，仿佛面对的不是仇敌而是一只蝼蚁

text.content: "Seeking death!" Zhao Yuan was enraged by that indifferent tone. His palms凝聚 spiritual energy as he pounced like a fierce tiger descending a mountain. The stands erupted in an uproar! Everyone assumed Chen Ji was doomed—except for those few知情者, whose lips curved into knowing smiles.

Zhao Yuan's strike was indeed fierce. Between the howling palm wind, there was a rare force among outer disciples—he had mastered the Splitting Stone Palm to great perfection, ordinary outer disciples couldn't even withstand three of his moves. However, facing these呼啸而来的双掌, Chen Ji merely sidestepped, letting the attack pass with nonchalant ease.

"What?" Zhao Yuan's pupils contracted slightly. His proud strike had actually been dodged so easily by this trash? Before he could react, Chen Ji's figure had already closed in like a ghost. One palm struck his shoulder. The force wasn't heavy, but precisely hit the node where his spiritual energy circulated.

Zhao Yuan felt half his body go numb, his gathered spiritual energy instantly scattered. His expression changed dramatically as he stumbled back two steps, gazing at Chen Ji in horror: "You... how could you..." Before he could finish, Chen Ji's second palm had already arrived, landing on the other side of his shoulder, also precisely at the spiritual energy node.

The entire arena erupted! Those disciples who had come to watch the show were all wide-eyed now, gazing at that former trash in disbelief—his movements flowed like clouds and water, each dodge perfectly avoiding Zhao Yuan's attacks, and his counterattacks... every palm was as precise as if rehearsed thousands of times!

dialogue.content: (Eyes suddenly changing) This guy... has been hiding his true abilities all along?

choice.prompt: How to end it with the third move?

choices.text: Kick him flying, clean and decisive
choices.description: End it with the most domineering posture, displaying absolute gap in strength, letting everyone see the chasm between trash and genius never truly existed.
choices.visible_reward: Maximum shock value across the arena
choices.risk_hint: Might expose too much strength, attracting more attention
choices.process_label: 陈机脚尖一点，身形暴起，一腿横扫而出

text.content: Zhao Yuan couldn't react in time. His entire body flew out like a broken kite, crashing heavily at the edge of the Martial Arena. When the dust settled, the entire venue fell into dead silence. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his robes perfectly still, as if he had merely done something insignificant.

choices.text: Press forward step by step, verbal humiliation
choices.description: Completely crush Zhao Yuan's spirit first. Each strike paired with heart-piercing words, making him lose all face. Fits Chen Ji's "sharp-tongued face-slapping" style.
choices.risk_hint: Might expose Chen Ji's vengeful personality trait
choices.process_label: 陈机缓步逼近，声音清冷地开口

text.content: "Earlier Brother Zhao said he'd make me kneel?" Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "Now it seems, the one who should kneel is someone else." When his words fell, Chen Ji's palm wind had already arrived. Zhao Yuan's knees bent involuntarily, and he crashed heavily to his knees!

dialogue.content: Three moves. More would be a waste.

text.content: The Martial Arena fell into an eerie silence. Everyone was processing what had just happened—that trash who was trampled underfoot without a sound, that wretch whom even servants dared to bully, had actually defeated outer disciple Zhao Yuan, ranked in the top twenty, in just three moves? And from his appearance, he clearly still had strength to spare!

dialogue.content: (Standing up abruptly) This is definitely not trash! He's been hiding it all along!

text.content: Above the platform, the elders' expressions varied. Grand Elder remained impassive, only his fingers stroking his beard pausing slightly; Fifth Elder's face was ashen, his gloomy gaze even more sinister; and sitting in the corner, Ling Yuan, in those murky old eyes of his, flickered with a meaningful light.

Chen Ji turned slowly, his gaze casually sweeping across the stands before pausing at a certain direction—where Han Lie was staring at him intently, his gaze complex. Beside Fifth Elder, a figure in inner sect robes rose quietly and slipped away—that figure... was Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: (Sighing softly in heart) Coming to probe again, aren't you, Senior Sister Su.

choices.description: Know when to stop, preserve trump cards. Make this victory seem like "luck" or "Zhao Yuan's carelessness," avoid exposing strength too early and attracting bigger troubles.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to expand influence
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as having unstable strength
choices.process_label: 陈机面无表情地朝裁判点了点头，转身便要离开

text.content: However, he had only taken two steps when a sharp voice came from behind: "Brother Chen Ji, please stay." Chen Ji's steps halted, the corner of his lips slightly rising—here it comes. Turning to look, it was indeed that inner sect disciple responsible for recording matches beside Fifth Elder, now looking at him with a thin smile. "Brother's victory in this match was rather suspicious. According to the rules, a spiritual examination is required."

choices.description: Since you've already acted, no need to hide. Step forward to meet all gazes, let them know through action: yes, I do have strength,不服来战.
choices.process_label: 陈机停下脚步，环顾四周，微微一笑

text.content: "Fellow brothers and sisters." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet it clearly spread across the entire Martial Arena. "Chen Ji has embarrassed himself today. If anyone不服—" His gaze slowly swept across the crowd before finally landing on Zhao Yuan still kneeling on the ground. "You may battle again next time." When his words fell, the entire arena erupted. This was clearly no trash? This was clearly a猛虎 revealing its fangs!

From the back of the crowd came a stir. Han Lie pushed through the crowd, striding toward the center of the Martial Arena. His tall figure cast a shadow under the sunlight. The gaze he turned toward Chen Ji burned with unprecedented battle intent: "Chen Ji是吧? I've remembered you. If we meet in the next round, don't make me失望."

dialogue.content: (Nodding slightly) Thank you for your esteem, Brother Han.

text.content:
Chen Ji responded indifferently, his tone betraying no fluctuations whatsoever. Han Lie snorted coldly and turned to leave, yet his clenched fists betrayed the excitement in his heart—finally, a worthy opponent worthy of serious attention had appeared. Not far away, Zhao Yuan finally struggled to his feet, his face covered in blood, kneeling in place. The look in his eyes toward Chen Ji was filled with fear and bewilderment.

废物? That word would from this day forward be forever unrelated to him.

In the shadows of a certain section of the stands, a pair of clear yet complex eyes were watching all this. Su Qingyao gently bit her lower lip, her fingertips trembling slightly—she became even more convinced that this "trash" carried secrets enough to overturn the entire Tianqing Sect. What would happen in the next chapter was destined to exceed everyone's expectations.
